versions.subject: Merge PR #5777 from @swachchhanda000 - feat: more edrfreeze rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|contains:
        - ':\Perflogs\'
        - ':\Temp\'
        - ':\Users\Public\'
        - '\$Recycle.Bin\'
        - '\Contacts\'
        - '\Desktop\'
        - '\Documents\'
        - '\Downloads\'
        - '\Favorites\'
        - '\Favourites\'
        - '\inetpub\wwwroot\'
        - '\Music\'
        - '\Pictures\'
        - '\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\'
        - '\Users\Default\'
        - '\Videos\'
        #  - '\AppData\Local\Temp\' some installers may load from here
selection_dll:
    ImageLoaded|endswith:
        - '\dbgcore.dll'
        - '\dbghelp.dll'
condition: all of selection_*
